name: Colorado
agency: Colorado Department of Revenue, Division of Motor Vehicles (DMV)
permitAge: 15 with an approved 30-hour driver education course; 15 1/2 with a 4-hour driver awareness program (until Jan. 1, 2027); 16 without either. From Jan. 1, 2027 (HB24-1021) applicants 15 to 17 need the 30-hour course

teen.nightLimit: First year of license (under 18): no driving midnight to 5 a.m., except work, school, medical emergency or emancipated minor, or with a parent/guardian or instructor
teen.passengerLimit: First 6 months: only passengers 21 or older; next 6 months: one passenger under 21; siblings and medical emergencies excepted; only one passenger in the front seat; everyone belted
teen.phone: Under 18: no phone use for any purpose, hands-free included, except to report an emergency. 18 and older: hands-free only since Jan. 1, 2025 (SB24-065); first offense $75 and 2 points

bac.under21: 0.02 (UDD, underage drinking and driving); DWAI at about 0.05 for all drivers

notes: Knowledge test count and pass mark (25 questions, 20 correct, 80%) come from secondary practice-test sites only; not confirmed on dmv.colorado.gov.
Test offered in English and Spanish, in office and via @Home online test; other spoken languages with a translator the test-taker provides (DMV).
Spanish handbook: the DMV Driver Education page and a 2022 press release say a Spanish edition exists (print/digital, myColorado app); direct PDF URL not found.
Permit supervisor: licensed driver 21 or older in the front passenger seat; parent/guardian signs the Affidavit of Liability.
Move over (HB23-1123, Aug. 7, 2023): any stationary vehicle with hazard lights; change lanes or slow to at least 20 mph below the posted limit.

Speed (C.R.S. 42-4-1101): 20 mph narrow winding mountain roads/blind curves, 25 business district, 30 residence district, 40 open mountain highway, 55 other open highways, 65 four-lane interstate/freeway; no limit above 75 mph anywhere.
Left lane law (C.R.S. 42-4-1013): on roads with limit 65 mph or more, far-left lane only for passing or turning left.
Left on red allowed from one-way onto one-way after stopping, unless signed otherwise.
School bus: stop at least 20 feet away (Colorado State Patrol via Eagle County Schools). Sources conflict on whether a painted median counts as divided; no question written on that point.
Points (CDOR): 17 and under, 6 in 12 months or 7 before 18; 18 to 21, 9 in 12 months, 12 in 24 months, 14 total.
Seat belts primary for drivers under 18 and all their passengers; secondary for adults.
Traction law (Code 15) / chain law (Code 16) on I-70 Dotsero to Morrison, Sept. 1 to May 31; tread depth figure (1/8 vs 3/16 inch) conflicts between sources, not used in questions.
